findings.claim: A store reset added inside an existing signOut body (signOut only on an unchanged line) matches no session trigger: spec S3's store-reset half has no case and the contract selects no surface.
findings.closure: A named case in test-audit-surface.sh where a store reset is added inside an existing signOut body selects session, with the trigger rule that makes it pass written into the contract.

findings.claim: migrate 'adds the addon dirs if wire already ran' has no detection rule and no test; a wired v2 project reinstalled without the addon flag gets server_roots [] and authz never arms.
findings.closure: A test-install.sh case where a v2 file whose protected_dirs already holds the addon dirs migrates to v3 with those server_roots, under a stated detection rule.

findings.claim: AC7 (explicit user request) and AC6's add-with-reason have prose writes but no case; T14 does not assert 'Audit added:' nor the user-request wording.
findings.closure: T14 also asserts 'Audit added:' and the explicit-user-request wording in ship.md 1bis, failing on today's file.

findings.claim: The v3 bump breaks test-hooks.sh (PC21, PC23, PC25a, PC30-PC32) and migrate's load_strict on a v2 file, while the plan declares test-hooks.sh unchanged and leaves v2 acceptance by _parse undecided.
findings.closure: The plan states whether _parse accepts schema 2 and with which server_roots, lists test-hooks.sh and project-defaults.records as edited with the PC pins rewritten under a recorded exception, and step 9 runs test-hooks.sh green.
